related.title: 5G QoS Flow：無線、傳輸與核心延遲帳本
related.titleEn: 5G QoS flow: radio, transport and core delay ledger
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付物能重現 10 dBm 與 23 dBm，保留失敗情境且每個通過判定有明確門檻；需分開列出模型未涵蓋的實際系統驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The artifacts must reproduce 10 dBm and 23 dBm, preserve failing scenarios and attach a threshold to each pass decision; list actual-system validation outside this model separately.
related.difference: 能推導並解釋10 ms與15 ms，建立qos_trace.csv、時間同步證據、各段餘裕表，並完成以下驗收：12 ms教學端到端預算只第一組通過；不能只靠無線2 ms便宣告服務符合。
related.differenceEn: Derive and explain 10 ms and 15 ms; create qos_trace.csv, clock evidence and per-segment margins; apply this acceptance decision: Only the first case meets a12 ms end-to-end budget; radio delay2 ms alone does not establish service acceptance.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 從原理 簡化P=min(Pmax,P0+alpha*PL+10log10M)，區分總功率與每資源功率；省略的閉環補償不可默認為已驗證。 展開基準式 min(23,-80+0.8*100+10*log10(10))；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：先算未截限10與26 dBm，再套上23上限；用功率餘裕欄記第二組缺3 dB。 將兩條推導一起存入 nr_power.csv、飽和前後數值、功率餘裕。
從原理 端到端序列處理的延遲需各段相加；切片標籤本身不會消除共同佇列與處理瓶頸。 展開基準式 2+3+4+1；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：以同一封包ID對齊四段時間戳，先校正時鐘再加總；查段落間空隙是否漏計。 將兩條推導一起存入 qos_trace.csv、時間同步證據、各段餘裕表。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Starting from Use simplified P=min(Pmax,P0+alpha*PL+10log10M), distinguishing total and per-resource power; omitted closed-loop terms remain unverified., expand baseline expression min(23,-80+0.8*100+10*log10(10)); record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Calculate unclipped10/26 dBm before imposing23; mark the second case as3 dB short in the power-headroom column. Save both derivations with nr_power.csv, clipped/unclipped values and power headroom.

Starting from Serial end-to-end delay adds segment delays; a slice label does not remove shared queues or processing bottlenecks., expand baseline expression 2+3+4+1; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Join four segment timestamps by packet ID, correct clocks, then sum; identify gaps omitted between segments. Save both derivations with qos_trace.csv, clock evidence and per-segment margins.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Wi-Fi 6E：6 GHz 與5 GHz的傳播比較
related.titleEn: Wi-Fi6E: comparing6 GHz and5 GHz propagation
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付物能重現 10 dBm 與 23 dBm，保留失敗情境且每個通過判定有明確門檻；需分開列出模型未涵蓋的實際系統驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The artifacts must reproduce 10 dBm and 23 dBm, preserve failing scenarios and attach a threshold to each pass decision; list actual-system validation outside this model separately.
related.difference: 能推導並解釋1.58362492095 dB additional loss與7.95880017344 dB additional loss，建立wifi6e_pathloss.csv、波長對照、環境/法規待查項，並完成以下驗收：原餘裕5 dB時6相對2.4的理想差已超過預算；不可保證穿牆覆蓋或任意國家可用頻段。
related.differenceEn: Derive and explain 1.58362492095 dB additional loss and 7.95880017344 dB additional loss; create wifi6e_pathloss.csv, wavelength checks and environment/regulation questions; apply this acceptance decision: A5 dB original margin cannot absorb the ideal6-versus2.4 difference; do not promise wall coverage or spectrum availability in every country.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 從原理 簡化P=min(Pmax,P0+alpha*PL+10log10M)，區分總功率與每資源功率；省略的閉環補償不可默認為已驗證。 展開基準式 min(23,-80+0.8*100+10*log10(10))；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：先算未截限10與26 dBm，再套上23上限；用功率餘裕欄記第二組缺3 dB。 將兩條推導一起存入 nr_power.csv、飽和前後數值、功率餘裕。
從原理 固定距離與天線增益的自由空間損耗差為20log10(f2/f1)；不把頻率差誤當法定發射功率差。 展開基準式 20*log10(6/5)；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：用波長平方比例反算，並在圖上明確標同距離；實際法規與設備模式另查當地規定。 將兩條推導一起存入 wifi6e_pathloss.csv、波長對照、環境/法規待查項。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Starting from Use simplified P=min(Pmax,P0+alpha*PL+10log10M), distinguishing total and per-resource power; omitted closed-loop terms remain unverified., expand baseline expression min(23,-80+0.8*100+10*log10(10)); record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Calculate unclipped10/26 dBm before imposing23; mark the second case as3 dB short in the power-headroom column. Save both derivations with nr_power.csv, clipped/unclipped values and power headroom.

Starting from At equal distance and antenna gains, free-space loss difference is20log10(f2/f1); this is not a difference in legally permitted transmit power., expand baseline expression 20*log10(6/5); record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Cross-check with wavelength-squared ratios and mark equal distance; actual regulations and device modes require local verification. Save both derivations with wifi6e_pathloss.csv, wavelength checks and environment/regulation questions.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
